about: Mapleton is a township in Wellington County, Ontario, northwest of Guelph—not a city. Drayton, Moorefield, and Alma sit among Mennonite and dairy farm country in the county’s northern agricultural heartland. About 11,000 people live in Mapleton Township.
seoSummary: Wellington County township of Drayton and Moorefield—Mennonite dairy country northwest of Guelph, not a city.
